Auto-mobile & Green Energy Project

An engineering development initiative exploring an electrically powered, gear-driven generator system for industrial and commercial applications.

About the project

The Adegan Auto-mobile & Green Energy Project is a proposed Nigerian engineering initiative focused on the design and development of an electric-motor-driven, gear-transmission and generator system. The concept brings together a motor, a multi-stage gear assembly, a generator, cooling components, electrical regulation and a protective enclosure.

The long-term vision is to investigate cleaner and more efficient ways to generate and use electrical power, with potential applications in industrial equipment, commercial facilities and future mobility-related engineering.

Development status: The project has not yet commenced physical implementation in Nigeria. The images on this page are concept and design illustrations, not evidence of a completed, tested or commercially operating machine.

Key engineering areas

Areas proposed for further design, engineering review and validation.

Drive and gear train

Electric motor input, gear stages, shafts, bearings, couplings and mechanical load management.

Generator and controls

Generator selection, output regulation, protection, instrumentation and electrical safety systems.

Cooling and enclosure

Air and liquid cooling concepts, heat rejection, vibration isolation and a serviceable protective case.

Important engineering note: A motor-driven generator does not create net energy by itself. Any practical system must have a defined external energy source and account for conversion losses. Performance, efficiency, safety, durability and environmental benefits remain to be established through engineering calculations, prototype testing and independent assessment.
